prohibited_claims: AI caused Chloe Moffat to die.
An automated system generated, scored, or escalated the anonymous complaint.
A named HR professional committed misconduct or is legally culpable.
The final coroner conclusion is known.
Chloe lacked resilience or was unable to tolerate ordinary workplace pressure.
public_ai_use_statement: No public evidence recovered in this estate establishes that AI, algorithmic monitoring, automated decision-making, or a vendor system was used in the Chloe Moffat process.

shared_failure_surfaces.ai_amplification_surface: automated intake, entity resolution, risk scoring, or cross-system enrichment could increase speed and confidence without improving source credibility
model-generated severity or policy labels could harden uncertain allegations before contextual review
workflow automation could preserve an informal label while automatically triggering formal-threat actions
access, communication, scheduling, or account controls can be applied immediately and across systems
wellbeing analytics can generate another score while leaving actual independent human support absent
summaries, recommendations, risk flags, and prefilled outcomes can compress the human reviewer into a ratifier
training on surviving cases can reproduce the original process while excluded, silent, exited, or harmed workers remain outside the validation set
